description: cache refresh indexes each record an entry reading binds with the context it bound under: entry.kdl sets the layered locale slot (base layer) and the plain region slot, then binds record one directly and record two under an override control (locale sv-se, layer override). The state gains the cache entry and one <key>.kdlith-snapshot entry whose header (kdlith-snapshot format=2 canonicalization=2), metadata line (key, entry as spelled, revision, schema fingerprint, profile selection, lineage [entry.kdl], record and slot counts, layout and body digests), and one index line per record in stream order (identity, type, source revision digest, source id, node index, span, snapshot id <key>/<n>, validation status, and every slot with its value and layer — base for one, override for two) are pinned byte for byte; no part file remains
